name: Leo Jankovic
about: I study Computer Science at Caltech, with a minor in Aerospace, and split my time between quant finance, building with AI, and computational biology. Outside of that I'm into muscle cars, I've spent time traveling around China and Malaysia, and I once did a seven-day meditation retreat at a monk's temple.

Alongside my coursework, I spend my summers in labs and internships rather than in the classroom: from investment analyst roles at Third Point and Engine No. 1, to research at Caltech's Anima AI + Science Lab, to earlier work engineering mass spectrometry methods at the Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology under Nobel laureate Emmanuelle Charpentier and running molecular dynamics simulations at Goethe University Frankfurt.
I'm always looking for interesting problems to work on and people to work with, so feel free to reach out.

news.text: Accepted an offer to join Mercuria as an Investment Analyst in Geneva, Switzerland, starting April 2027.
Joined AllyAI as a Forward Deployed Engineer, deploying customized AI solutions for enterprise customers.
Wrapped up a stint as a Quantitative Investment Analyst at Third Point.
Joined Caltech's Anima AI + Science Lab as a researcher, working on computational modeling for catheter-based biomedical devices.
Joined Engine No. 1 as an Investment Analyst.
Awarded the Tim Ryan Fellowship ($40,000) to build an AR/VR application for people with dementia and Alzheimer's disease.

projects.name: Autonomous Delivery Robot with Hot-Swap Battery Dock
projects.text: An autonomous rover and servo-driven dock that swaps batteries in under 30 seconds. Chassis and dock modeled in Fusion 360; C++ motor control on Arduino and vision-based navigation on Raspberry Pi.

projects.name: Mission Concept: Robotic Lander to Enceladus
projects.text: Led mission operations for a Caltech Ae105b design study of a lander to Saturn's moon Enceladus: gravity-assist trajectory, delta-V budget, and the surface operations schedule.
